item.title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 Review | NoobFeed
item.description: Wasbir from NoobFeed writes: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 feels like a new game in the year 2025. It's not just nostalgia or old hype—it's a new speed boost, fresh character drops, and a surprisingly passionate community that have made it one of the most durable Musou games ever.

item.title: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition Review | NoobFeed
item.description: Adiba from NoobFeed writes: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition runs far better than expected, the narrative remains gripping, and despite visual compromises, the overall experience still shines. Even at $20 or less on some platforms, some fans may wish more effort had gone into this version, but the Switch 2 release nonetheless stands as a technically remarkable way to revisit Lara Croft's origin story after its official arrival on Nintendo hardware.

item.title: Japanese Charts: Kirby Air Riders Is Off To A Flying Start
item.description: Kirby has proven his absolute dominance in the region once again, with Kirby Air Riders getting off the start line in style with a sweet 195,594 sales under its belt. It's nothing compared to the 380,000 debut that The Forgotten Land mustered back in 2022, but for a game as niche as Air Riders, it ain't bad going!

item.title: The retro-inspired creature-collecting RPG, ‘Doki Monsters: Quest’, is now available on the Switch
item.description: 'The Warsaw-based (Poland) indie games publisher and developer RedDeer.Games, today announced with great thrill and happiness that their retro-inspired creature-collecting RPG, ‘Doki Monsters: Quest’, is now available on the Switch.' - Jonas Ek, TGG.

item.title: ‘Beyond Words’ is coming to PC and consoles in early 2026
item.description: 'PQube is proud to announce it will publish Beyond Words, the latest creation from Steve Ellis and David Doak of Mindfuel Games, the legendary developers behind GoldenEye 007 and TimeSplitters. (which is coming to PC and consoles in early 2026)'. - PQube.

item.title: The psychological horror adventure, ‘The 9th Charnel’, is coming to consoles on January 30th, 2026
item.description: 'Horror fans, get ready for a wave of goosebumps as The 9th Charnel, the upcoming psychological horror adventure, is set to launch on January 30, 2026, for PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S. The game will be available in physical and digital editions.' - SAIKAT DEB CREATIONS and SOEDESCO.

item.title: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted Blends Old And New In A Nostalgic Release- Skewed and Reviewed
item.description: Skewed and Reviewed have posted a review for the retro game and found it ideal for fans of the original.

item.title: Dispatch Review – Twisted Voxel
item.description: Dispatch is a rare example of a narrative adventure that understands exactly what it wants to be and executes its vision with finesse.

item.title: ‘Tormented Souls 2’ has now sold over 100K copies since it’s release
item.description: 'The terror has returned stronger than ever: Tormented Souls 2, the chilling follow-up to the acclaimed 90s survival-horror throwback from PQube and Dual Effect, has officially surpassed 100,000 copies sold worldwide since launching just over a month ago on 23rd October.' - PQube and Dual Effect.
